notes: Query of an account balance after posting (legacy GET_BAL): posted entries up to the date + opening balance, per account and optional cost centres; the generated editable grid on AC_YEARLY_TRN_DET was wrong (the form only displays). See processes/AC_QUERYAFTER.md

proc.description_a: الإستعلام عن رصيد حساب بعد الترحيل: الرصيد = القيود المرحلة حتى التاريخ + الرصيد الافتتاحي، لمراكز التكلفة المختارة (أو كلها عند تركها فارغة).
proc.description_e: Account balance after posting: posted entries up to the date + opening balance, for the chosen cost centres (all when empty).

params.name: ACCOUNT_NUMBER
params.lov_sql: select account_number || ' - ' || account_name d, account_number r from ac_master where account_status = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or account_number in (select m2.account_number from ac_master m2, ac_password_master p2 where p2.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p2.company_code = to_number(:G_COMPANY_CODE) and rpad(substr(to_char(p2.account_number), 1, p2.account_end_pos), 12, '0') = rpad(substr(to_char(m2.account_number), 1, p2.account_end_pos), 12, '0'))) order by account_number

params.name: COST_CODE
params.lov_sql: select cost_code || ' - ' || cost_desc d, cost_code r from ac_cost_centers where cost_status = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or cost_code in (select m2.cost_code from ac_cost_centers m2, ac_password_cost1 p2 where p2.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p2.company_code = to_number(:G_COMPANY_CODE) and rpad(substr(to_char(p2.cost_code), 1, p2.cost_end_pos), 9, '0') = rpad(substr(to_char(m2.cost_code), 1, p2.cost_end_pos), 9, '0') and m2.cost_status = 1)) order by cost_code

params.name: COST_CODE2
params.lov_sql: select cost_code || ' - ' || cost_desc d, cost_code r from ac_cost_centers2 where cost_status = 1 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or cost_code in (select m2.cost_code from ac_cost_centers2 m2, ac_password_cost2 p2 where p2.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER) and p2.company_code = to_number(:G_COMPANY_CODE) and rpad(substr(to_char(p2.cost_code), 1, p2.cost_end_pos), 9, '0') = rpad(substr(to_char(m2.cost_code), 1, p2.cost_end_pos), 9, '0') and m2.cost_status = 1)) order by cost_code

proc.preview_sql: select m.account_number, m.account_name, c.currency_desc currency_name, abs(b.bal) balance, app_rules3_gl.side_text(b.bal) nature from ac_master m left join ac_currency c on c.currency_code = m.currency_code cross join (select app_rules3_gl.account_balance(to_number(:P10180_ACCOUNT_NUMBER), to_number(:P10180_COST_CODE), to_number(:P10180_COST_CODE2), to_date(:P10180_DATE_W, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 0) bal from dual) b where m.account_number = to_number(:P10180_ACCOUNT_NUMBER) and :P10180_DATE_W is not null
